abstract: The OECD's 2025 Education at a Glance report examines AI's differential impact across education sector roles. Teaching positions demonstrate significant resistance to automation with only 15% task exposure, while related education occupations such as support staff, administration, and tutoring roles face substantially higher displacement risk ranging from 30-40% task exposure to AI automation.
keyFindings: Teaching roles are among the least automatable occupations with 15% task exposure to AI.
Education support staff face 30-40% task displacement from AI automation.
Education administration positions face 30-40% task displacement from AI automation.
Tutoring roles face 30-40% task displacement from AI automation.
qualifiers: Limited excerpt available; full methodology, data sources, time period, and analytical approach not provided in source text.
